steps.label: Fill Part A (type, state, district, legal name, PAN, email, mobile)

steps.reason: Check every value. Then type the captcha and press PROCEED yourself; enter the mobile and email OTPs yourself on the next page. Note the TRN the portal shows (it is also sent by SMS and email) and use it for Part B within 15 days. VCFO Assist does not press PROCEED, read the captcha or touch an OTP.
